{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Count total rows
print("Total rows:", len(df))

# Count unique patient_id values
print("Unique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Count number of rows where biomarker_baseline is -999
print("Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Count number of patients with multiple sample_seq (i.e., re-tested)
df_duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print("Number of patients with multiple sample_seq:", df_duplicates['patient_id'].nunique())

# Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
print("Rows after removing biomarker_baseline == -999:", len(df_clean))

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
print("Final number of unique patients (after deduplication):", len(df_dedup))"}
